# Review Power Platform Solution

Assess the solution for:

1. Business alignment
2. Dataverse design quality
3. Canvas app usability
4. Power Fx maintainability
5. Power Automate reliability
6. Security model
7. Accessibility
8. ALM readiness
9. Testing gaps
10. Demo readiness

Return:

- Recommended changes before customer demo
- Questions to ask the customer
- Suggested next backlog items
